fields.display_title: This paper proposes a transductive few-shot classification method on the basis of the simple Conditional Neural Adaptive Processes (CNAPS) introduced by Bateni et al. The proposed method, called transductive CNAPS, extends the simple CNAPS by exploiting the query set both in the feature adaptation stage and classification stage. Extensive experiments are conducted on Meta-Dataset, mini-ImageNet and tiered-ImageNet, and very competitive results are reported.
